items.headline: Mutual fund portfolio asset mix alters capital gains tax treatment
items.hook: Portfolio allocation shifts holding-period thresholds and final redemption tax rates unexpectedly.
gist: Fund category alone does not determine capital gains tax on mutual funds.
Underlying asset allocations dictate applicable tax brackets and minimum holding periods.
Investors must verify real-time asset breakdowns before redeeming mutual fund units.

items.hook: Bank credit and GST receipts counter rising crude prices across domestic balance sheets.
gist: CEA stated India's economy remains resilient despite global financial and geopolitical headwinds.

Global interest rate trajectories and elevated crude oil import costs.

items.headline: RBI files caveat in Bombay HC after rejecting Tata Sons' NBFC deregistration bid
items.hook: Tata Trusts faces unprecedented public governance scrutiny over its corporate control powers.

Whether Tata Sons files for court relief or secures an RBI reconsideration.

gist: August CPI rose to 4.8%.

items.hook: Global funds pulled ₹5,109 crore out of Indian government debt in mid-September.

items.headline: Bank of Korea signals caution after split vote on August interest rate hike
items.hook: Rising loan delinquencies are challenging the Bank of Korea's latest interest rate hike.
gist: The Bank of Korea raised interest rates in August despite a dissenting vote.

Watch South Korean delinquency rates and inflation prints for signs of a pause.

items.headline: India edible oil imports hit 11-month high of 1.57 million tonnes in August
items.hook: Local refiners accumulated a record volume of foreign soyoil ahead of major festivals.
gist: India's edible oil imports rose to an 11-month high of 1.57 million tonnes in August.
Refiners aggressively stocked up on palm and soyoil to prepare for upcoming festival demand.
What to watch is whether high inventory levels lead to slower imports next month.

items.headline: India trade deficit narrows to $26.86 billion as gold imports plunge

gist: India's trade deficit narrowed to $26.86 billion in August as exports surged.
Faster export growth and lower gold imports ease pressure on the Indian rupee.
Whether global demand holds up to sustain this decade-high export growth pace.

items.headline: Sensex slides 778 points as Brent crude tops $109 and US yields breach 5%

gist: Crude topped $109 and US yields hit 5.04%, driving Indian equities to multi-month lows.

items.headline: Indian banks offer personal loans starting at 8.90% in September 2026
